Step 2

Build the episode prompt

Copy the saved prompt into Codex. It requires the final red-team pass and returns one JSON block for the next step.

Loading master video rules Checking the current APC-AI-OS source and version. 
Choose an episode and generate the prompt.

Step 3

Import and verify the script

Paste the final JSON block returned by Codex, or choose its JSON file. Episode Studio validates the episode ID, master-rule hash, red-team result and five hook checks.

Earlier prompt and package versions remain in the timeline. Importing a revision does not overwrite their audit trail.

Step 4

Film and edit from one page

The latest imported package is stored in Content OS and rendered here as an HTML filming page. Earlier versions remain in the audit timeline.

Open an episode with an imported package to see its script, filming board, overlays, captions and edit notes.

Steps 5 to 7

Review, publish and learn

Save the hash-based final review, then send the same episode ID to Content OS when you publish. The 24h, 7d and 28d analytics stay attached automatically.

Publish + start analytics

Import video review

Paste the review manifest returned after a full, delta or final video audit. The video SHA-256 prevents findings from an older export being mistaken for the latest cut.
